scope: Local linked capture/replay of decoder layers 0, 17 and 35 from the first real tile; B4,N1797,H32,D64, M7188, QKV K2048,N6144. Cached latent; no fresh full-video decode quality or timing.
conclusion: Do not promote. Exact repaired BM128 saves only 0.0072-0.0224 ms in the complete local chain; layer17 improves in 3/6 paired blocks. BM64 regresses. Current advertised encode/decode numbers remain unchanged.
chronology: First capture attempt correctly rejected default comfy-kitchen 0.2.31 before model capture. Its metadata/error are preserved. All actual capture, quality and timing paths then used the isolated 0.2.34 overlay.
Initial fused BM128 and BM64 reproduce every raw QKV FP16 element but fail normalized Q/K (maximum absolute difference 0.00390625); V remains exact. No timing was performed for these failing kernels.
Production PTX uses four consecutive FP32 squared values accumulated serially, then a 16-group butterfly xor8,4,2,1. Direct tl.sum on the GEMM MMA-derived layout changes the reduction tree.

One explicit-tree repair was allowed. Real layer0 FP32 Q/K sums and pre-RoPE FP16 normalized values are bitwise identical at ROWS64 and ROWS128. Actual fused non-debug outputs and separate STORE_RAW debug outputs are checked independently.

Three real layers retain exact Q/K/V, original strides, original Torch Flash dispatch, exact Flash outputs and exact downstream INT8 output projection. Each measured operation includes fresh dynamic activation quantization and all per-call allocations.
Six paired ABBA/BAAB blocks per layer, ten chain calls per segment, three warmups. Full order and all samples are retained. No full decoder/video timing, no production edits, no promotion.
complete_local_chain: CK rowwise INT8 input quantization + QKV GEMM/FP16 epilogue + RMSNorm/RoPE + actual ATen Flash + nan_to_num_ + reshape + original INT8 output projection, including per-call allocations.
diagnostic_preparation_warning: The diagnostic_preparation entries are single short batches without paired blocks. They exclude Flash and output projection and are not the performance conclusion.
status_warning: A raw harness status=passed means the run completed; individual candidate quality.passed fields remain authoritative, including the preserved initial failures.

reduction_tree_evidence.tree: p=(x0*x0+x1*x1); p=x2*x2+p; p=x3*x3+p; for shift in [8,4,2,1]: p=p+shuffle_xor(p,shift)
reduction_tree_evidence.scope: Compiler/layout-specific observed contract; exactness validated on captured inputs, not a universal guarantee for all compilers or arbitrary inputs.

privacy: Local absolute paths removed; model tensor/weight/latent files are not included. Their original checksums and public-model basenames are retained. No private media names are present.

plan.json.mechanism: Fuse QKV INT8 GEMM FP16 output directly into headwise RMSNorm/RoPE; retain original Q/K/V strides and actual Torch Flash dispatch

contract.epilogue: FP32(acc)*FP32(act_scale), explicit fma(value,weight_scale,FP32(bias)), FP16 rounding before RMSNorm
contract.norm_rope: Original FP32 squared sum/rsqrt, normalized FP16 rounding, separate FP16 cos/sin products before FP16 final sum
contract.shapes: original Q/K contiguous BNHD; V retains BNH(3D) stride backing

historical_coverage.new_boundary: No previous local QKV GEMM fused with the headwise norm/RoPE consumer found

diagnostic_budget.interpretation: Mechanism budget only, not a promised local or full-decoder saving. New reduction layout/register costs must be measured.

plan.json.capture: Same-call CK QKV linear observed by actual weight pointer and reconstructible q/s/w/ws/b; immediate RoPE input checked by output pointer. Clone to CPU; unchanged compiled tile must stay exact. Flat runtime module import.
plan.json.numerical_gate: First capture layer0 and quality-only. Verify raw GEMM FP16 output, original Q/K/V values and strides, actual Torch Flash kernel and downstream INT8 projection. Do not time/promote failing specialization; STORE_RAW diagnosis is separate from timed kernel.
plan.json.timing: Fresh dynamic input quantization and all output allocations included; complete local chain includes Flash/nan_to_num/output reshape/INT8 projection. No profiler or capture observer during ABBA/BAAB timing.
